name: Linton University College

sources.note: Cached homepage confirming specializations and partner universities
Lists programme areas: engineering, quantity surveying, architecture, construction management, IT, computer science, business, accounting, art/design, nursing. 200+ MOHE approved courses.

notes: Linton University College. Part of KTG Education Group. Website inaccessible at time of collection. Program data reconstructed from Wikipedia and Wayback Machine cached homepage. Specializes in engineering, construction management, IT, business, architecture, visual arts, nursing. Partners with Leeds Beckett University and Bolton University (UK). Affiliated institutes: ITP, IISM, Jati. 30,000+ graduates in 75 countries. Located in Mantin, Negeri Sembilan.

fees.notes: Linton's domain no longer resolves (DNS NXDOMAIN, checked 2026-09-18). The last official published fee schedule is effective 1 Feb 2014 (archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20141231060716id_/http://www.linton.edu.my/admission/financial-fees): 3-year degree/diploma tuition RM64,210 total (RM22,080 + RM21,065 + RM21,065) and 4-year tuition RM85,275. No newer official fee schedule was found in Wayback archives (2015-2024); see individual programme records.
